description.value: This exploratory analysis examined whether pre-quit regional gray matter volume measured by voxel-based morphometry was associated with a 4-week smoking cessation treatment outcome.

Adult smokers underwent an open label smoking cessation treatment trial with anatomical MRI scans at baseline, before the target quit date, and after the quit date; the reported VBM analysis used scans collected prior to the quit date.

spans.text: Scanning sessions were conducted at three time-points: 1) at baseline [prior to switching to RNC cigarettes]; 2) in the week prior to the target quit date; and 3) 2–4 weeks following the quit date. We analyzed anatomical scans collected prior to the quit date (Scan 1, n = 16 or Scan 2, n = 2).
